finding: Previous consent-first JS isolated each tab. Revocation in tab A could leave already-loaded GA4 script in tab B until the tab resumed or its own consent check ran; browser network behavior unproven.

fixed_in_staging.behavior: On explicit reject of an opted-in tab, stop local GA sender, clear versioned marker and known analytics cookies, broadcast 'reject' to same-origin tabs, then reload if tag was initialized. Receiving tabs stop/reload but never echo; only rejection signals travel, no acceptance grant.
fixed_in_staging.fallback: On visibilitychange or pageshow a tab with an initialized GA4 tag checks consent cookies; if stale/withdrawn, rejects locally, clears cookies and reloads if needed.
fixed_in_staging.cleanup: Legacy first-party Google _gcl_* as well as _ga, _ga_*, _gid, _gat*, _gac_* cookies now deleted on revoke, across host-only and site domain variants to the extent supported by browser cookie rules. Unrelated session_auth cookie preserved.
fixed_in_staging.privacy: No cross-tab personal identifier or user payload. Broadcast is same origin. No localStorage identifier is introduced. Channel closed on dispose.
